reason: J's exact typed path vocabulary covers 99.6% of valid path occurrences; the median molecule has zero unseen path mass.
The 12.1% of molecules with any unseen path mass already have 2.7x higher P3B MAE, but J does not improve them (it is worse overall and on the path-unseen group).
A 3k/6k label curve would therefore mostly re-measure the same shared hard-core error, not distinguish label shortage from readout/ownership failure.
The hard cap is 0.8594 A100-h; a 0.30 h curve would consume budget needed for the one matched two-arm intervention.
reconsider_if: A future arm shows a positive rare-subgroup effect that is diluted in the overall MAE; then a 3k/6k curve becomes the right next diagnostic.
